_comment: SKY STONE IS NOT LOOT WITHOUT AE2 (#276, mechanism revised in review of #277).
The Sky Stone Shard is OUR item, so it is registered in every install and sits in Slag Rubble's
pull stream unconditionally. This file takes it back out again when AE2 is absent - which is the
whole gate, and the reason slag_rubble_pulls.json can name the shard directly instead of
reaching for a conditional table it might not be able to resolve.
neoforge:not inverts the usual guard: the modifier loads only when ae2 is MISSING. That is
measured behaviour, not assumed - a loot_modifiers file does honour neoforge:conditions, probed
by putting a mod_loaded guard on no_saplings.json, at which point the sapling lockout stopped
TEMPORARY. It is pack content living in the engine because the pack cannot ship data on 26.1.2,
and it leaves with the press pool - Flatts3000/trashlands#46. Removal is this file, the second
pool in slag_rubble_pulls.json, the four guarded recipes, and the shard item itself.
conditions[] is the vanilla loot-condition list and is deliberately EMPTY: the invariant is
global rather than per-table. Without AE2 a Sky Stone Shard is not loot anywhere, from any
source, which is the same shape as the sapling lockout beside it. Aiming it would not be
possible anyway - neoforge:loot_table_id compares getQueriedLootTableId(), which is never set on
a table rolled programmatically, and every pull stream in this mod is rolled that way.
